Si profesionalni prevajalec iz angleščine v slovenščino. Tvoja naloga je ustvariti visoko kakovostne prevode, ki so naravni, tekoči in natančni. Izogibaj se dobesednim prevodom, ki zvenijo nenaravno. Upoštevaj kontekst, idiome in kulturne reference. Ne dodajaj nobenih dodatnih informacij ali komentarjev, samo prevod.

Prevedi podano angleško besedilo v slovenščino.

Limited Screen Time
Parenting styles regarding children and the use of the latest technologies vary greatly. A quick look reveals two extremes. On one hand, there are parents who buy their children tablets, phones, and computers and encourage them to use these devices constantly. On the other hand, there are parents who strictly limit or even prohibit access to these devices. However, technology also offers intermediate solutions.

In 2008, the British Prime Minister commissioned a special report, known as the "Byron Review," authored by Dr. Tanya Byron. The report focused primarily on computer games and internet use, especially social media, which was rapidly gaining popularity at the time. The report's findings were not surprising. Children primarily use new technologies for playing games and socializing with peers. If children are exposed to appropriate games and content, this can be a beneficial tool for learning and development.

The report also highlights the significant responsibility of parents, the state, and the industry. When using modern technologies, all parties must protect children by preventing access to harmful content through content classifications and tools that adhere to these classifications.

Digital Dementia
While Dr. Byron's report was relatively positive, on the other hand, we can mention the efforts of German psychiatrist Dr. Manfred Spitzer, who, through his research and books, warns of the serious (harmful) consequences of using modern technologies on children's brains.

Dementia is a medical condition that usually affects older people. Excessive use of computers and smartphones can trigger processes in young brains that are very similar to dementia, affecting children's cognitive abilities. Dr. Spitzer has termed this condition digital dementia.

One of his most radical recommendations to parents is to not allow children to use computers or phones until they are 12 years old, and then no more than 1 hour per day until they are 18, and even then, only for tasks that are absolutely necessary for school. This is a guideline that is difficult to implement today, given the pressure from society and peers.

However, parents have some mechanisms available to limit excessive or harmful use of modern devices. So, if you are among those who are a little more radical than average, read on.

How to Tame the Computer?
The first requirement to maximize the benefits offered by Microsoft is to have a suitable operating system. Although Windows 8.1 also has some parental control tools, Windows 10 is much more powerful in this area. Since Windows 7 and 8.1 can still be upgraded to Windows 10, it is worth doing so, especially for parental control purposes.

Secondly, we need to set up a Microsoft Account (formerly known as LiveID) for ourselves and our children. We understand that this may not appeal to everyone, but the benefits are too great to ignore. As always, it is worth being honest and entering the correct age information when creating these accounts, as the system will only be able to tailor content to your child if it has accurate information.

We will add our children (or their Microsoft accounts) to our control panel within the Microsoft account. Once this is done, we can start with the more detailed settings.

One of the most interesting options is to limit the amount of time children can spend in front of the computer screen. For example, the author of this article uses the following method: the child chooses which days of the week and during what time they would like to access the computer, and we set the maximum total time they can spend in front of the screen. This allows the child to easily complete, for example, schoolwork on the computer, while also being flexible enough to accommodate other school obligations. For example, we can allow the child to use the computer for 1 hour on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays between 11:30 AM and 4:00 PM. How they distribute this time is up to them and their schedule, but they will not be able to access their desktop for more than one hour on these days.

What if the child urgently needs access to the computer? This is also possible, and Microsoft has made it very convenient. Through the user interface in Windows 10, the child can ask parents to extend the time they are allowed to log in to the desktop. If one of the parents is logged in to their computer (Windows 10) at the time of the request and their user account is linked to the Microsoft identity, the system will also display this request among the notifications. It only takes one click to allow the child 30 minutes, an hour, or more. The user will also receive an email with convenient links to different length "extensions," with the shortest being 15 minutes. Given that almost everyone carries an email in their pocket today, this is a very elegant solution.

However, this is not the only option that Microsoft offers for free. We can prohibit the use of certain applications and programs or create a list of allowed applications. If the child uses (or is only allowed to use) the Edge browser, we will also receive a weekly report on the websites visited, or simply a total of the time spent using a particular application.

Of course, the computer or the child's desktop must also be properly prepared. Through the control panel (the new control panel in Windows 10), we add our children's accounts to the computer – but not as administrators or regular users. Microsoft has provided a special category of child accounts for this purpose. Once this is done, the child can immediately log in to the computer and encounter the restrictions that we set through the parent's Microsoft account.

We are confident that Microsoft has taken the right approach to the problem of parental control and that this will appeal to most parents, especially since it is part of the operating system (in conjunction with the Microsoft account) and no additional products need to be paid for.

What about smartphones?

Since children are now much more proficient in using phones than computers, it may be even more important to set limits on phone use (or does anyone still use tablets?).

In addition to technically simple methods, such as agreeing that the phone is in the living room every evening at 8:00 PM, more tech-savvy users can use a wireless router that automatically turns off the wireless network during rest time. Of course, this only works if the child does not have a data plan.

It is a misconception that it is much more difficult to limit the use of phones than computers. This may stem from the fact that children are much more familiar with them than adults and that these are devices that are difficult to interfere with without violating warranty terms. However, there are also effective solutions available for the world of phones and tablets that allow us to set the limits that children need.

In our opinion, the most versatile application in this area is simply called ScreenTime and is available for both Android and Apple phones.

Installation is very simple and can be done in two steps. We install the ScreenTime application on the child's phone, and then we scan the code with our phone to get the control panel on our phone. All settings can therefore be done from our phone. It should be noted that all of this loses its meaning if one of the parents is also logged in to the child's phone (e.g., Google account), as we often see with less tech-savvy parents.

The ScreenTime application is not free, or rather, in its free mode, it offers very little: monitoring the use of one of the child's devices and reporting on web browsing. If we want to implement some restrictions, we will have to pay.

The annual subscription is just under 35 euros. This is not a small amount, but it is not a lot either, especially since we can cover all devices and all children, i.e., the whole family.

What impressed us about the ScreenTime application? First, the relatively simple user interface. But most of all, we were impressed by the application's capabilities, which can relieve the worries of concerned parents. We can avoid many arguments about not using phones at the table (with one button, we can temporarily stop all activities on the phone), that use is not allowed at night, and that there is also time for learning and the like.

The developers of the service clearly understand what worries parents (and ultimately teachers) when it comes to the use of mobile phones, so we can set "school time" and "sleep time." In each of these, we can turn on or off the applications that are allowed (and, yes, we can completely prohibit the installation of new applications). The list of applications from which we can choose is, of course, the same as on the child's phone.

It will take some getting used to and finding the right combinations to get a well-functioning system. If we allow the child to access phone calls but do not allow them to access contacts, we have effectively disabled them, because who knows any phone numbers by heart today.

A separate list is also the explicitly prohibited applications, and, most importantly, we can set the maximum time that we allow the child to spend on the phone – separately for school days and for weekends. To make it even more useful, we can exclude certain applications from this time and allow the child unlimited calling or, for example, unlimited use of the calculator.

ScreenTime allows us to view the total time spent per day, view past searches, and also view the history of web browsing. It also provides some education. We can set tasks that the child must regularly perform (e.g., tidy their room, load the dishwasher, etc.), and when they do, we reward them with extra time.

ScreenTime
What: An application for parental control of phones.
Who: www.screentimelabs.com.
Price: 35 EUR per year.
For: Ease of installation and use, capabilities.
Against: Price.

Omejeni čas pred zaslonom
Vzgojni modeli staršev so, vsaj glede otrok in uporabe najnovejših tehnologij, na moč različni. Če se malo ozremo naokrog, opazimo dve skrajnosti. Na eni strani imamo starše, ki svojim otrokom kupijo tablico, telefon in računalnik in jih na vsakem koraku spodbujajo, naj vse to tudi uporabljajo. Na drugi strani pa imamo starše, ki dostop do teh naprav strogo omejujejo in tudi preprečujejo. Tehnologija pa omogoča tudi vmesne rešitve.
e leta 2008 je britanski premier naročil posebno poročilo, ki je zaradi znanstvenice dr. Tanye Byron, ki ga je napisala, znano kot »Byron Review«. Poročilo se je posvetilo predvsem računalniškim igram in uporabi interneta, še posebej družabnih omrežij, ki so se takrat nesluteno razmahnila. Ugotovitve poročila niso bile presenetljive. Otroci nove tehnologije uporabljajo predvsem za igranje igric in za druženje s sovrstniki. Če so otroci izpostavljeni primernim igram in vsebinam, je to zanje lahko dobrodošel pripomoček pri učenju in razvoju.
Poročilo pa izpostavlja tudi veliko odgovornost staršev, države in industrije. Pri uporabi sodobnih tehnologij morajo namreč vsi omenjeni otroke zaščititi, da jim ob pomoči klasifikacij vsebin in orodij, ki te klasifikacije upoštevajo, preprečijo dostop do škodljivih vsebin.
Digitalna demenca
Če je bilo poročilo dr. Byronove razmeroma pozitivno naravnano, pa lahko, na drugi strani, navedemo prizadevanja nemškega psihiatra, dr. Manfreda Spitzerja, ki skozi svoje raziskave in knjige opozarja na resne (škodljive) posledice uporabe sodobnih tehnologij na možgane otrok.
Demenca je bolezensko stanje, ki navadno prizadene starejše. Pretirana raba računalnikov in pametnih telefonov lahko v mladih možganih sproži demenci zelo podobne procese, ki vplivajo na kognitivne sposobnosti otrok. Dr. Spitzer je tako stanje poimenoval kar digitalna demenca.
Eno izmed njegovih najbolj radikalnih navodil staršem je, naj otrokom pred 12. letom sploh ne dovolijo uporabe računalnikov in telefonov, nato pa do 18. leta ne več kot 1 uro na dan, pa še to le za tiste opravke, ki so nujno potrebni za šolo. Navodilo torej, ki ga danes, ob vsem pritisku širše družbe in vrstnikov, dokaj težko udejanjimo.
Pa vendar je staršem na voljo nekaj mehanizmov, s katerimi lahko pretirano ali škodljivo uporabo sodobnih naprav zamejimo. Če ste torej med tistimi malce bolj radikalnimi od povprečja, berite naprej.
Kako ukrotiti računalnik?
Prvi pogoj, da čim bolj izkoristimo možnosti, ki nam jih daje Microsoft, je primeren operacijski sistem. Čeprav ima Windows 8.1 tudi nekaj starševskih orodij, je Windows 10 na tem področju kljub vsemu precej zmogljivejši. Ker lahko Windows 7 in 8.1 še vedno nadgradimo na Windows 10, se prav zaradi starševskega nadzora to splača storiti.
Drugo, kar bomo morali urediti tako zase kot za otroke, pa je tako imenovani Microsoft Account (včasih smo temu rekli LiveID). Verjamemo, da to marsikomu ne diši preveč, a so koristi prevelike, da bi se zaradi tega sedaj ustavili. Kot vedno, se pri ustvarjanju teh računov splača biti iskren in vpisati pravilne podatke o starosti, saj bo sistem le tako znal prilagoditi vsebine vašemu otroku.
Na svoji nadzorni plošči znotraj Microsoftovega računa bomo torej dodali svoje otroke (oziroma njihove Microsoftove račune). Ko je to opravljeno, se lahko lotimo bolj vsebinskih delov nastavitev.
Ena izmed zanimivejših možnosti bo gotovo omejitev časa, ki ga otroci lahko preživijo pred zaslonom računalnika. Za zgled navedimo način rabe, ki ga, denimo, prakticiram tudi avtor tega članka: otrok si sam izbere, ob katerih dnevih v tednu in v kakšnem časovnem razponu bi želel dostopati do računalnika, na nas pa je, da določimo maksimalen skupni čas, ki ga sme preždeti pred zaslonom. Otroku to omogoča, da lahko brez težav opravi, denimo, delo na računalniku, ki je potrebno za šolo, obenem pa je ta način tudi dovolj elastičen, da se prilagaja drugim šolskim obveznostim. Navedimo zgled: otroku dovolimo, da ob ponedeljkih, torkih in četrtkih med 11.30 in 16.00 uporablja računalnik po 1 uro. Kako si bo porazdelil čas rabe, je odvisno torej samo od njega oziroma njegovega urnika, a več kot eno uro ob teh dnevih ne bo mogel dostopati do svojega namizja.
No, kaj pa, če otrok izredno potrebuje dostop do računalnika? Tudi to je mogoče, Microsoft pa je to izpeljal nadvse priročno. Prek uporabniškega vmesnika v Windows 10 lahko otrok prosi starše, naj mu podaljšajo čas, ko se sme prijaviti na namizje. Če je nekdo od staršev v času takega zahtevka prijavljen v svoj računalnik (spet Windows 10) in je tudi njegov uporabniški račun povezan z Microsoftovo identiteto, bo med obvestila sistema dobil tudi to prošnjo. Potreben je samo en klik, da otroku dovolimo 30 minut, uro ali več. Obenem pa bo uporabnik dobil tudi elektronsko pošto, v kateri so priročno že ustvarjene povezave do različno dolgih »podaljškov«, z najkrajšim, ki je 15 minut. Glede na to, da danes že praktično vsi nosimo elektronsko pošto v žepu, je tako podaljševanje zelo elegantno.
Ni pa to edina možnost, ki nam jo ponuja Microsoft brezplačno. Prepovemo lahko uporabo določenih aplikacij in programov oziroma sestavimo seznam dovoljenih. Če otrok uporablja (ali pa sme uporabljati le) brskalnik Edge, vsak teden dobimo tudi poročilo o obiskanih spletnih straneh, drugače pa le seštevek časov, ko je bila določena aplikacija v rabi.
Seveda pa je treba pravilno pripraviti tudi računalnik oziroma otrokovo namizje. Prek nadzorne plošče (nova nadzorna plošča v Windows 10) dodamo v računalnik račune svojih otrok – seveda ne kot upravitelje ali navadne uporabnike. Microsoft je za to predvidel posebno kategorijo otroških računov. Ko je to urejeno, se lahko otrok takoj prijavi v računalnik in pri tem že naleti na omejitve, ki jih nastavljamo prek starševskega Microsoftovega računa.
Prepričani smo, da se je Microsoft tokrat lotil problema starševskega nadzora na pravi način in da bo večini staršev to odgovarjalo, še posebej, ker je to del operacijskega sistema (v navezavi z Microsoftovim računom) in ni treba plačevati drugih izdelkov.
Kaj pa pametni telefoni?
Ker so otroci danes že precej bolj vešči uporabe telefonov kot računalnikov, je tako morda še pomembneje, da postavimo meje rabi telefonov (ali danes še kdo uporablja tablice?).
Poleg tehnično nič kaj naprednih prijemov, kot je na primer dogovor o tem, da je telefon, denimo, vsak večer od 20. ure v dnevni sobi, pa si bolj vešči lahko omislijo brezžični usmerjevalnik, ki omogoča avtomatično izklapljanje brezžičnega omrežja v času počitka. Seveda to deluje le, če otrok v naročniškem razmerju nima vključenega podatkovnega prometa.
Zmotno je prepričanje, da je uporabo telefonov precej težje zamejiti kot uporabo računalnikov. Najbrž izvira iz tega, da so otroci z njimi precej bolj domači kot odrasli in da so to naprave, v katere (s sistemskega stališča) precej težko posegamo, ne da bi pri tem kršili garancijske pogoje. Pa vendar so tudi za svet telefonov in tablic na voljo učinkovite rešitve, s katerimi postavimo meje, ki jih otrok vsekakor potrebuje.
Po našem prepričanju je najbolj vsestranska aplikacija na tem področju enostavno poimenovana kar ScreenTime in je na voljo tako za androidne telefone kot telefone Apple.
Namestitev je sila enostavna in jo opravimo v dveh korakih. V otrokov telefon namestimo aplikacijo ScreenTime, nato pa s svojim telefonom poskeniramo kodo in tako na svoj telefon dobimo nadzorno ploščo. Vse nastavitve lahko torej opravimo s svojega telefona. Najbrž ne bo odveč omeniti, da vse skupaj izgubi smisel, če je med računi v otrokovem telefonu prijavljen tudi kateri od staršev (npr. Google account), kot večkrat opazimo pri tehnično manj veščih starših.
Aplikacija ScreenTime ni brezplačna, oziroma v svojem brezplačnem načinu delovanja omogoča bore malo: spremljanje rabe ene naprave otroka in poročanje o spletnem brskanju. Če bomo hoteli vpeljati tudi nekaj omejitev, bo treba seči v žep.
Letna naročnina je slabih 35 evrov. To sicer ni malo, pa tudi veliko ne, še posebej, ker lahko s tem pokrijemo vse naprave in vse otroke, torej celotno družino.
Kaj nas je torej navdušilo v aplikaciji ScreenTime? Kot prvo, že razmeroma enostaven uporabniški vmesnik. Najbolj pa navdušijo prav zmogljivosti aplikacije, ki lahko zaskrbljenemu staršu odvalijo kamen od srca. Izognemo se lahko številnim prepirom o tem, da se za mizo ne uporablja telefonov (z enim gumbom začasno ustavimo vse dejavnosti na telefonu), da ponoči uporaba ni dovoljena in da je tudi čas za učenje in podobno.
Snovalcem storitve je očitno povsem jasno, kaj najbolj muči starše (in navsezadnje tudi učitelje), ko gre za rabo mobilnih telefonov, zato lahko določimo »čas za šolo« in »čas za spanje«. V vsakem od teh pa po lastni presoji vklapljamo ali izklapljamo aplikacije, ki so dovoljene (in, da, nameščanje novih lahko povsem prepovemo). Seznam aplikacij, s katerega lahko izbiramo, je seveda tak kot na otrokovem telefonu.
Treba bo nekaj privajanja in iskanja pravih kombinacij, da bomo dobili dobro delujočo celoto. Če bomo otroku dovolili dostop do uporabe telefonskega klica, ne bomo pa mu omogočili dostopa do stikov, smo ga pravzaprav onemogočili, kajti kdo pa danes še ve kakšno številko na pamet.
Poseben seznam so tudi izrecno prepovedane aplikacije in, kar je za marsikoga najpomembneje, določimo lahko maksimalen čas, ki ga otroku dovolimo pred telefonom – ločeno za šolske dni in za konec tedna. Da pa bi bilo vse skupaj še bolj uporabno, lahko določene aplikacije izvzamemo iz tega časa in otroku omogočimo neomejeno klicanje ali, denimo, neomejeno rabo kalkulatorja.
ScreenTime omogoča pregledovanje skupnih seštevkov porabljenega časa po dnevih, pregled preteklih iskanj in tudi zgodovino brskanja po spletu. Poskrbljeno pa je tudi za nekaj vzgoje. Določimo lahko opravila, ki jih mora otrok redno opravljati (denimo pospraviti svojo sobo, napolniti pomivalni stroj ...), in ko to opravi, ga nagradimo z dodatnim časom.
ScreenTime
Kaj: Aplikacija za starševski nadzor telefonov.
Kdo: www.screentimelabs.com.
Cena: 35 EUR na leto.
Za: Enostavnost namestitve in uporabe, zmogljivost.
Proti: Cena.

What is inflammation?
Inflammation is caused by tissue damage and, according to classical medicine, is characterized by four attributes:
- calor (heat), elevated temperature in the affected area
- dolor (pain)
- rubor (redness) in the affected area
- tumor (swelling)

Damaged cells release inflammatory signaling molecules (histamine and prostaglandin), which lead to the dilation of capillaries in the affected area. Histamine and prostaglandin also cause an increase in temperature and blood flow (redness) in the affected area. These signaling molecules have two additional effects:

Biochemical nature of inflammation
The main players in inflammation are white blood cells, primarily macrophages. These cells adhere to the capillary walls and migrate into the damaged tissue. In organs where macrophages cannot function (e.g., the brain), microglia cells take over. In simple terms, there are two important activities of white blood cells involved in inflammation: (1) fighting infection and (2) communicating with other white blood cells.

Again, in a simplified manner, NO synthase 2 (NOS2) is responsible for fighting infection, producing disinfectants, primarily nitric oxide (NO) and oxygen radicals. For communication, the enzyme cyclooxygenase (COX) is responsible for producing prostaglandins and leukotrienes – immune communication molecules. The genes for NOS2 and COX are controlled by a common regulator called NF-κB (a transcription factor). Macrophages in inflammation, of course, also perform other tasks, such as cleaning up (phagocytizing damaged cells and tissue debris). In lymph nodes, macrophages present the bacteria to initiate another immune response.

Anti-inflammatory drugs
Anti-inflammatory drugs are divided into two main types: allosteric and genomic modulation. Allosteric drugs include aspirin, paracetamol, ibuprofen, and similar analgesics, which act directly on cyclooxygenase and thus shut down inflammatory immune communication. Genomic modulation drugs, on the other hand, act directly on the NF-κB regulator, which controls the transcription of both NOS2 and COX in the cell. Genomically modulating anti-inflammatory drugs include corticosteroids, ginseng, and many other adaptogens.

When inflammation becomes harmful
Inflammation is an effective response to injury and infection. However, sometimes inflammation becomes harmful. Malignant inflammation occurs, for example, in the case of stroke (cerebral or cardiac) or alcohol poisoning of the brain and liver. This inflammation is sterile (without infection), and macrophages unnecessarily release reactive radicals (NO, superoxide, etc.) to fight infection. By inhibiting inflammation, we can significantly reduce tissue damage in both stroke and poisoning.

Chronic inflammation
Another type of malignant inflammation is chronic inflammation. Chronic inflammation is often sterile (non-infectious), such as rheumatoid arthritis or autoimmune inflammation of other organs. Chronic inflammation can also be infectious. Infectious chronic inflammation of viral or bacterial origin occurs when the patient's immune system is insufficient to clear the infection. While autoimmune inflammation is very suitable for inhibition with adaptogens, chronic infectious inflammation requires antibiotic therapy.

Pain in inflammation
Pain is one of the fundamental characteristics of inflammation. Pain in inflammation serves a simple purpose: to allow the damaged parts of the body to rest. Pain relief usually means treatment, so pain suppression is generally desirable. However, remember that pain is only a symptom. Pain should naturally disappear when the cause of the inflammation is resolved.

The anti-inflammatory effect is characteristic of adaptogens
Inflammation and the associated pain are linked to most diseases. Therefore, it is not surprising that adaptogens, which have the ability to modulate inflammation, have been hailed as a "panacea." Ginseng is one such adaptogen, and its effects are scientifically proven and can be attributed to ginseng steroid glycosides – panaxosides. However, many other classical adaptogens also have greater or lesser anti-inflammatory effects. To demonstrate that these are not just superstitions or myths (as some doctors believe), I will present a detailed account of ginseng, which can be extrapolated to other adaptogens.

Why ginseng inhibits inflammation and pain
Ginseng glycosides (panaxosides) consist of a steroid core (aglycone) to which several sugar residues are attached. The ginseng aglycone is called panaxatriol. Panaxatriol is derived from panaxosides in the intestine by the action of intestinal bacteria, which remove the sugar residues, leaving only the bitter aglycone, which is easily absorbed into the bloodstream due to its non-polar nature. Panaxatriol belongs to the triterpenoids or steroids. Some steroids are endogenous hormones in the body, but panaxatriol is a phytosteroid (plant steroid) and does not naturally occur in our body. Ginseng and other plants offer their phytosteroid as a medicine that acts on our own steroid receptors. Panaxatriol inhibits pain in ginseng, just as our corticosteroids do. An animal, bird, reptile, or snake that suffers from pain in the forest for a long time will eat some red berries and seeds because animals and birds spit them out. Panaxatriol from the berries enters the animal's bloodstream and then (similar to other steroids) passes through the cell membrane directly into the nucleus, where it slows down the inflammatory and pain processes by acting on the transcription factor NF-κB (see the diagram above). (This fact is supported by the scientific study Oh2004 and many others.) The animal will remember the red berries and consume them again, even if they are not very sweet. The seeds will germinate, and new ginseng seedlings will grow in a remote part of the forest. (At least, that was the case in the past.) Today, the animal called a human comes to ginseng, takes some berries for free, digs up the ginseng plant, and takes it to the city to sell it for a lot of money. After some time, large mushrooms grow in the forest, and sick animals have to rely on less effective adaptogens, such as Chinese clown leaf, which grows high on the forest floor and in the roots does not have a drug store.)

The effect of ginseng is somewhat more complex
If we focus less on the entertainment and more on the science, we can see that ginseng contains many more medicinal compounds than panaxatriol. As mentioned, these compounds are called panaxosides and are glycosides partially derived from panaxatriol and partially from panaxadiol, another basic phytosteroid in ginseng. In addition, panaxosides can be absorbed into the bloodstream even if they are not chewed or bitten. One of the most abundant panaxosides in ginseng is ginsenoside Rb1, which has strong anti-inflammatory properties. Its partially hydrolyzed version is called compound K and is also strongly anti-inflammatory. The study Park2005eeg showed that both inhibit NF-κB, thereby reducing the production of NO and prostaglandin E2 in activated macrophages. The anti-inflammatory effect is also observed with ginsenoside Rc (Yu2016grf) and other panaxosides (Kim2009grg). Ginsenosides Rh1 and Rh2, according to Park1996gri and Park2003aag, block the development of allergic reactions, and their anti-allergic effect is stronger than that of conventional anti-allergics. In addition to ginseng, ginseng and ginseng notoginseng (Li1999aet, Jin2007iep) also have anti-inflammatory effects. Studies by Kim2010pfc, Yu2016grf, Shin2005egr, and many others confirm the effect of ginseng on gastritis, hepatitis, arthritis, dermatitis, and other organs. There are so many studies on the anti-inflammatory effect of ginseng that it is impossible to report on them all.

The anti-inflammatory effect of ginseng is scientifically proven
In general, it can be said that the anti-inflammatory and analgesic effects of ginseng are scientifically proven. Ginseng is suitable for relieving muscle pain after exercise and sports, for controlling liver inflammation in acute or chronic poisoning, for controlling inflammation in people with diabetes, for controlling brain inflammation in stroke and cerebral hemorrhage, for suppressing myocardial infarction in the same infarction, and for suppressing organ inflammation in autoimmune diseases (e.g., rheumatoid arthritis). It is a pity that such a versatile medicine faces distrust, misunderstanding, and pre-colonial doubts. Similarly, there are other anti-inflammatory adaptogens.

Other adaptogens with anti-inflammatory effects
Anti-inflammatory adaptogens are often so well-known that they are called ginseng or become part of our diet as spices. One example is ashwagandha, which is called "Indian ginseng." Another example is ginger and turmeric, which have become part of our diet as spices and are therefore often consumed by people who are not even aware of their medicinal effects. The mechanism of action of other anti-inflammatory adaptogens is often similar to that of ginseng. For example, ashwagandha achieves its long-term effect by acting on NF-κB, similar to many ginsenosides (Rasool2006irw, Grover2010ina). The anti-inflammatory effects of ginger and turmeric are described in Grzanna2005ghm, Bright2007cad, and Lakhan2015zep. Another interesting anti-inflammatory adaptogen is Baikal skullcap (Yoon2009aes, Dong2015bil), whose flavonoids block allergic reactions (Jung2012aes, Bae2016bic, Shin2014ssb), act against asthma (Jang2012sii, Mabalirajan2013bra), and calm mast cells (Hsieh2007bii, Shin2014pes). Due to the correlation between inflammatory processes and cancer growth, it should be mentioned that skullcap is one of the most frequently prescribed herbal medicines for cancer.

The list of plants with anti-inflammatory effects does not end here. There is also Chinese gentian, which is called "female ginseng" or "ginseng for the poor" because of its phytosteroid content and offers anti-inflammatory effects at a lower price (Xu2008tsw), French maritime pine bark (Mobasheri2012iih), Pycnogenol (Liu2016paa, Kolacek2013enp, Khan2013pmn, Fan2015par), wine resveratrol (Mobasheri2012iih), lotus calum, and many others. Not every anti-inflammatory plant is an adaptogen – for example, even an old anti-inflammatory agent like salicylic acid (Vlachojannis2009sre) has significant side effects (stomach irritation), which is why chemists modified it into aspirin and eventually synthesized it.

The anti-inflammatory effect of glossy ganoderma is summarized in the review Bhardwaj2014sia, which cites numerous experimental studies. The study Choi2014aho attributes it to certain triterpenoids of this fungus (butic acid E2, butic acid D2, butic acid P, butic acid Q, ganoderiol F, methyl ganoderate J, and butic acid N). According to Wu2016glb, glossy ganoderma has an anti-inflammatory effect due to the oxidative effect of cholesterol.

Kaj je vnetje
Vnetje povzroča poškodba tkiva in po klasični medicini je značilna štiri atribute:
- kalorična toplota, povišana temperatura vnetega dela telesa
- dolor - bolečina
- rje - pordelost vnetega telesa
- otekanje tumorja
Poškodovane celice sproščajo vnetne signalne molekule (histamin in prostaglandin), ki vodijo do širjenja kapilar vnetega telesa. Histamin in prostaglandin povzročata tudi zvišano temperaturo in krvni obtok (pordelost) vnetih delov telesa. Te signalne molekule imajo še dva učinka:
Biokemijska narava vnetja
Glavni del vnetja so bele krvne celice, večinoma makrofagi. Belih krvnih celic se drži kapilarne stene in prodrejo v poškodovano tkivo. V organih, kjer makrofagov ne more (možganov) deluje v celicah mikroglije. Na preprost način obstajata dve pomembni dejavnosti, ki sodelujejo pri vnetju belih krvnih celic: (1) boj proti okužbam in (2) komuniciranje z drugimi belimi krvnimi celicami.
Še enkrat poenostavljeno, za okužbo je odgovorna NO sintaza 2 (NOS2) , ki proizvaja razkužila, predvsem dušikov oksid (NO) in kisikove radikale. Za komunikacijo je encim ciklo-kislazaza (COX) odgovoren za tvorbo prostaglandinov in levkotrienov - imunske komunikacijske molekule. Gene NOS2 in COX nadzira skupni krmilnik, imenovan NF-κB (transkripcijski faktor). Makrofagi v vnetju, seveda, rešujejo druge naloge, kot so čiščenje (fagocitoza poškodovanih celic in delov tkiva). V bezgavkah makrofagi predstavljajo bakterijo, ugotovljeno za drug imunski odziv.
Protivnetna zdravila
Protivnetna zdravila (protivnetna zdravila ) so razdeljena na dve glavni vrsti: alosterična in gensko modulacija . Allosterična zdravila vključujejo aspirin , paracetamol, ibuprofen in podobne analgetike, ki delujejo neposredno na ciklooksigenazo in s tem izklopijo vnetno imunsko komunikacijo. Genomična modulacijska zdravila na drugi strani delujejo neposredno na krmilnik NF-κB, ki nadzira transkripcijo obeh NOS2 in COX v celici. Genomsko modulirajoča protivnetna zdravila vključujejo kortikosteroide, ginseng in mnoge druge adaptogene.
Ko vnetje boli
Vnetje je učinkovit odziv na poškodbe in okužbe. Vcasih pa je vnetje škodljivo. Maligno vnetje nastane, na primer, v primeru možganskega in srčnega možganskega kapi ali alkoholne zastrupitve možganov in jeter . Ta vnetja so sterilna (brez okužbe) in makrofagi po nepotrebnem sproščajo reaktivne radikale (NO, superoxide ...) za boj proti okužbam. Z zaviranjem vnetja lahko močno zmanjšamo poškodbe tkiva tako pri kapi kot tudi pri zastrupitvi.
Kronično vnetje
Druga vrsta malignih vnetij je kronično vnetje. Kronično vnetje je pogosto sterilno (neinfekcijsko), na primer revmatično vnetje sklepov (revmatoidni artritis) ali avtoimunsko vnetje drugih organov . Kronično vnetje je lahko tudi nalezljivo. Nalezljivo kronično vnetje viralnega ali bakterijskega izvora nastane, kadar bolnikova imuniteta ni zadostna za dokončanje okužbe. Medtem ko je avtoimunsko vnetje zelo primerno za zaviranje adaptogenov, zahteva kronično infekcijsko vnetje antibiotično terapijo .
Bolečine v vnetju
Bolečina je eden od osnovnih lastnosti vnetja. Bolečine v vnetju služijo preprosto, da lahko poškodovani deli telesa dajo mir. Odvzem bolečine običajno pomeni zdravljenje, tako da je bolečina zatiranje na splošno zaželeno. Vendar ne pozabite, da je bolečina samo simptom. Bolečine bi morale naravno izginiti, ko se vzrok vnetja razreši.
Učinek proti vnetjem je značilen za adaptogene
Vnetje in bolečine, povezane z njo, so povezane z večino bolezni. Zato ni čudno, da je "panacea" osvojila adaptogene, ki imajo možnost vdihniti vnetje. Sem spadajo ginseng , ki me bolj zanima tukaj. Njeni učinki so znanstveno dokazani in jih je mogoče pripisati ginseng steroidnim glikozidom - pankoksidom. Vendar pa imajo številni drugi klasični adaptogeni večji ali manjši protivnetni učinki. Da bi dokazali, da niso vraževerstva ali izmišljotine (kot včasih mislijo zdravniki), bom predstavil podroben gnosis za ginseng, ki ga zapuščam za druge adaptogene.
Zakaj ginseng zavira vnetje in bolečine
Ginseng glikozidi (panaxosides) sestavljajo steroidno jedro (aglikon), na katerega je vezanih več ostankov sladkorja. Ginseng aglycon se imenuje panaxatriol . Panaxatriol izvira iz pankoksidov v črevesju s požiranjem črevesnih bakterij iz sladkih ostankov sladkornega trsa, pri čemer ostane le grenak aglikon, ki se zaradi svoje nepolarne narave zlahka absorbira v krvni obtok. Panaxatriol spada v triterpenoide ali steroide. Nekateri steroidi so lastni hormoni v telesu, vendar pa je panaxatriol med fitosteroidi (rastlinskimi steroidi) in se v našem telesu seveda ne pojavlja. Ginseng in drugi vretenčarji ponujajo svoj fitosteroid kot zdravilo, ki deluje na naših lastnih receptorjih steroidov. Panaxatriol ginseng zavira bolečine, tako kot naši kortikosteroidi. Žival, ptica, kuščar ali kača, ki v gozdu dolg čas trpi bolečino, gola in siri nekaj rdečih jagod in semen, ker živali in ptice pljuvajo. Panaxatriol iz jajčec ginseng prodre v bolnišnični krvni obtok in nato (podobno kot drugi steroidi) prodre skozi celično membrano neposredno v jedro, kjer vnetje in bolečine upočasnijo delovanje z transkripcijskim faktorjem NF-κB (glej sliko zgoraj). (To dejstvo dokazuje znanstvena študija Oh2004 in mnogi drugi.) Očiščena žival bo dobro zapomnila rdeče jagode in jih porabila, tudi če niso preveč sladka. Semena bo seveda izhajala iz nje, nadaljnje sadike ginsenga pa bodo rasle v oddaljenem kraju gozda. (Vsaj to je bilo v preteklosti.) Danes se ginjerska žival, imenovana človek, pridi v ginseng, in namesto tega odvzame nekaj jagod za brezplačno, izvleče lopatko, in lepo ginseninsko rastlino razpoči celotno trgovino z drogami in se izkoplje v mesto in zamenja za kup juana. Čez nekaj časa se v gozdu rastejo velike gobice, bolne živali pa se morajo zanašati na manj učinkovite adaptogene, kot je kitajski listnat klovn, ki cveti in raste visoko na drevesnem dnu in v koreninah nima trgovine z drogami.)
Učinek ginsenga je nekoliko bolj zapleten
Če manj poudarimo zabavo in več znanosti, lahko vidimo, da ginseng vsebuje veliko več zdravilnih učinkovin kot pankatriol. Kot je bilo rečeno, se te snovi imenujejo pankoksidi in so glikozidi delno pridobljeni iz pankatriola in delno iz pankardiola , drugega osnovnega fitosterida ginsenga. Poleg tega se lahko panaxosides absorbirajo v krvni obtok, tudi če niso lajeni ali ugrizani. Eden od najobsežnejših pankoksidov v ginsengu je ginsenoside Rb 1 , ki je močno protivnetno. Njegova deloma griza verzija se imenuje spojina K in je prav tako močno protivnetna. Študija Park2005eeg je pokazala, da oba zavirajo NF-κB, s čimer se zmanjša proizvodnja NO in prostaglandina E2 v aktiviranih makrofagih. Učinek vnetja je tudi na ginsenosidu Rc ( Yu2016grf ) in drugih pankoksidih ( Kim2009grg ). Ginsenosides Rh 1 in Rh 2 glede na Park1996gri in Park2003aag blokirajo razvoj alergijske reakcije, njihov anti-alergijski učinek pa je močnejši kot boljši od običajne anti-alergije. Proti vnetjem, ne samo ginseng, ampak tudi ginseng in ginseng notoginseng ( Li1999aet , Jin2007iep ). Študije o Kim2010pfc , Yu2016grf , Shin2005egr in mnogi drugi potrjujejo učinek ginsenga na želodčno vnetje (gastritis), vnetje jeter (hepatitis), vnetje sklepov (artritis), vnetje kože (dermatitis) in druge organe. Študije o protivnetnem učinku ginsenga so velike (več kot 200) in o njih ni mogoče poročati.
Protivnetni učinek ginsenga je znanstveno dokazan
Na splošno je mogoče reči, da je znanstveno dokazano, da je ginseng učinkovit proti vnetjem in bolečinam . Ginseng je primeren za zatiranje bolečine v mišicah po vadbi in športu , za nadzor vnetja jeter v akutni ali kronični zastrupitvi, za nadzor vnetja pri ljudeh s sladkorno boleznijo , za nadzor vnetja možganov tako pri kapi kot pri kapi, za zatiranje miokardnega infarkta v istem infarktu in dušenje vnetje organa pri avtoimunskih boleznih (npr. revmatoidni artritis ). Škoda, da se takšno vsestransko zdravilo sooča z nezaupanjem, nesporazumom in predkolonialnimi dvomi. Podobno obstajajo tudi drugi protivnetni adaptogeni.
Drugi adaptogeni z protivnetnim učinkom
Protivnetni adaptogeni so bili pogosto tako dobro znani, da se imenujejo ginseng ali postanejo del naše prehrane kot začimbe. Prvi primer je življenje smrčanja , ki se imenuje " indijski ginseng ". Druga je primer ingverja in kurkuma z dolgim ušesi , ki so postali del naše prehrane kot začimbe in zato jih pogosto porabijo tisti, ki sploh ne zavedajo svojih zdravilnih učinkov . Mehanizem delovanja drugih protivnetnih adaptogenov je pogosto podoben ginsengu. Na primer, vitania doseže svoj dolgoročni učinek z delovanjem na NF-κB podobno kot pri mnogih ginsenozidih ( Rasool2006irw , Grover2010ina ). Učinki ingverja in kurkuma proti vnetjem so opisani v Grzanna2005ghm , Bright2007cad in Lakhan2015zep . Zelo zanimiv protivnetni adaptogen je tudi Baikal Shihak ( Yoon2009aes , Dong2015bil ), katerega flavonoidi blokirajo alergijsko reakcijo ( Jung2012aes , Bae2016bic , Shin2014ssb ), delujejo proti astmi ( Jang2012sii , Mabalirajan2013bra ) in pomirjajo mastocite ( Hsieh2007bii , Shin2014pes ). Zaradi korelacije med vnetnimi procesi in rakastimi rastmi je treba omeniti, da je šihash ena izmed najpogosteje predpisanih rastlinskih zdravil proti raku.
Seznam rastlin, ki učinkujejo proti vnetjem, se ne konča. Anti-vnetna je kitajska encijana , ki se zaradi vsebnosti fitosteridov imenuje " ženski ginseng ", " Ginseng za revne ", ki nudi protivnetne učinke po nižji ceni ( Xu2008tsw ), plodni puščici ( Mobasheri2012iih ), Pycnogenol Liu2016paa , Kolacek2013enp , Khan2013pmn , Fan2015par ), vino resveratrol ( Mobasheri2012iih ), lotus kalum , Kirilova lasna linija in mnogi drugi. Ni vsaka protivnetna rastlina je adaptogen - na primer celo celo staro protivnetno sredstvo, kot je Vlachojannis2009sre, ima pomembne neželene učinke (draženje želodca), zaradi česar so ga kemičniki predelali v aspirin in sčasoma sintetizirali.
Protivnetni učinek sijajnega sijajnega sijaja povzema pregled Bhardwaj2014sia , ki navaja številna eksperimentalna dela. Študija Choi2014aho jo pripisuje določenim triterpenoidom te glive (butil lucidat E2, butil lucidat D2, butil lucidat P, butil lucidat Q, ganoderiol F, metil ganodenat J in butil lucidat N). Po Wu2016glb glossy sladoled deluje proti vnetjem zaradi oksidativnega učinka holesterola.

Spark plug -- A spark plug (sometimes, in British English, a sparking plug, and, colloquially, a plug) is a device for delivering electric current from an ignition system to the combustion chamber of a spark-ignition engine to ignite the compressed fuel/air mixture by an electric spark, while containing combustion pressure within the engine. A spark plug has a metal threaded shell, electrically isolated from a central electrode by a porcelain insulator. The central electrode, which may contain a resistor, is connected by a heavily insulated wire to the output terminal of an ignition coil or magneto. The spark plug's metal shell is screwed into the engine's cylinder head and thus electrically grounded. The central electrode protrudes through the porcelain insulator into the combustion chamber, forming one or more spark gaps between the inner end of the central electrode and usually one or more protuberances or structures attached to the inner end of the threaded shell and designated the side, earth, or ground electrode(s).

Among the pests in the garden, snails are among the most troublesome. They are not only harmful because they significantly reduce the yield and quality of vegetables by contaminating them with slime, but they also suffer from fungal and bacterial diseases. How should one deal with snails in the garden?
Snails feed on fallen and damaged leaves, and then move on to healthy plants, affecting them as well. The greatest damage to plants in the garden is caused by snails in the second half of summer, especially during wet periods, and particularly in areas with loamy or clayey soils, and in neglected crops where the soil does not warm up sufficiently.
Snails are nocturnal and hide during the day in cool, shady places under boards and in ditches. Bright daylight is harmful to their development and feeding, so they live in moist areas of the garden. In the absence of moisture and a drop in temperature to 4-7°C, the mollusks die.
There are several types of snails found in the garden.
Networked Snail
This type of snail is light gray in color with a yellowish or reddish tint. The body length of an adult reaches 5-6 cm, and there are small black spots and dots on its back. The larvae feed on decaying leaves and other organic waste. Adults damage the green parts of plants, as well as fruits and berries.
Field Snail
Representatives of this type of snail have a light yellow color with a brownish tint. The field snail hibernates in the soil, under weeds, and other objects in the garden bed. The mollusks live for 6-7 months. In the spring, young snails emerge from the overwintered eggs, which become adults after two months. A new laying of snail eggs occurs in the second half of summer and autumn.
Control Measures
Combating snails requires a comprehensive approach, but preventive measures should not be forgotten.
- Regularly remove weeds and mow the grass on the edges of the plot, as well as around vegetable beds. Since snails hide in dense vegetation and cannot tolerate strong sunlight, removing the grass will protect the area from these pests.
- Clear the area to reduce excessive moisture in the soil.
- Avoid dense plantings of vegetables: these are prime locations where snails hide.
- Place citrus peel baits between rows, such as lemon, orange, or grapefruit.
- In small garden areas, you can plant parsley, which repels snails.
- Snails also avoid garden areas that are mulched with pine needles.
To eliminate snail habitats, bury glass bottles cut from plastic bottles in the ground and fill them with beer. Snails will crawl into the bait in large numbers. A few of these bait stations will keep your garden free of pests for the rest of the season.

Prolonged sitting for extended periods poses a risk to our health. While sitting, we expend less energy than when moving, which consequently reduces our metabolism. Over time, this increases the risk of developing obesity and related problems, such as high blood pressure, elevated blood glucose, and cholesterol, or a cluster of problems known as metabolic syndrome. A predominantly sedentary lifestyle over an extended period poses a health risk, regardless of whether we are sitting at work or at home in front of the television.

Physical activity helps to counteract the negative effects of sitting.
The negative consequences of prolonged sitting can be reduced with certain measures. Studies have shown that even a two-minute light physical activity, such as walking every 30–60 minutes, helps to eliminate the negative effects of sitting and has a positive impact on blood glucose and cholesterol. Several shorter breaks have shown a more favorable impact on health than fewer longer breaks, for example, 15 minutes every four hours. It is advisable to get up and walk around and stretch during longer periods of sitting, such as when working at a computer. The negative consequences of sitting can be partially counteracted with regular physical activity. In general, 150 minutes of moderate or 75 minutes of intense physical activity per week is recommended to maintain health. For additional positive health effects, 300 minutes of moderate or 150 minutes of intense physical activity per week is recommended. A study showed that people who perform sedentary jobs, such as drivers, need more physical activity. 60–75 minutes of moderate physical activity per day helps to reduce the risks associated with excessive sitting. Moderate physical activity includes brisk walking, cycling, and basketball, while intense physical activity includes running, swimming, and soccer. In addition, muscle-strengthening exercises should be performed twice a week, such as weight training or exercises using one’s own body weight.

If we have to sit a lot, we should do it correctly.

One of the very important criteria for a healthy diet is the production method. In other words, how was our food produced? Modern conventional (intensive) agriculture produces food laden with pesticides and using mineral fertilizers, which irreparably damages soil fertility, health, and life. The regular use of these substances leaves behind devastated soil, which becomes infertile, compacted, and dead.
Conventional agriculture, through the use of artificial mineral fertilizers (nitrogen and phosphorus), has caused both increased crop growth and yield, but also over-nutrition, making plants and crops less resistant and more susceptible to diseases, pests, and other environmental influences.
The solution was found in pesticides (herbicides, fungicides, insecticides), which began to be used to protect vulnerable plants and crops. Thus, conventional agriculture dominated the era of organic farming, and the use of plant protection products (pesticides) ultimately destroyed life both above and below the ground.
The era of artificial fertilizers and pesticides has reduced biodiversity and rapidly killed the entire range of (micro)life in the soil (and above it): from field flowers and plants, earthworms, spiders, woodlice, mites to microorganisms.
Today, even earthworms are an endangered species. In Germany, for example, as many as 65% of the 43 earthworm species studied are classified as rare to extremely rare. This is an unimaginable statistic for the future, as earthworm excrement contains 5 times more magnesium and nitrogen, 7 times more phosphorus, and as much as 11 times more potassium than good garden soil.
In addition to harming life and ecosystems, conventional agriculture consumes more energy per unit of crop and final product and pollutes groundwater and other water sources.
Food produced conventionally is depleted of biologically active substances and trace elements and contains more toxins and nitrates, which directly harm our health. There are many reasons, therefore, to choose naturally or organically produced food.
Natural or organic food production
Natural farming takes into account the laws of nature and all its aspects of life and tries to completely eliminate or, to the greatest extent possible, reduce the impact on the environment in the broadest sense, through the sensible (use) of natural resources.
Organic farming is a form of agriculture whose goal is to produce food using natural substances and processes (without the use of mineral fertilizers, chemically synthesized plant protection products, and genetically modified organisms), thereby limiting and minimizing the impact on the environment.
A special branch of organic farming is so-called peaceful farming, which is, in its essence, most committed to nature and the environment, as it does not use manure or fertilizers derived from dead livestock for fertilizing fields, and above all, it does not exploit animals in any form: neither for livestock farming nor for dairy farming.
Despite the content similarity, the terms "natural farming" and "organic farming" are not synonyms. Natural farming is a broader concept. This means that organic farming is a type of natural farming, or, in other words, organic agriculture is a type of natural agriculture.
And this type of agriculture was known to humanity until the end of the 19th century, when the first mineral fertilizers appeared. Later, the chemical industry developed the war gases from World War I into substances that we know as pesticides (insecticides, herbicides, etc.) – for growing plant varieties intended for our food and for (livestock) animals.
Supporting organic farmers is important not only because of the effects of organic food on our health but also because of the limited impact that this type of agriculture has on the environment and nature. If we really want to preserve the richness, diversity, and variety of all forms of life for our descendants, we must be smarter and, above all, more compassionate and considerate in our actions.
Some additional benefits of organically produced food
- Fresh, organically produced fruit contains, on average, more vitamins, minerals, enzymes, and other micronutrients compared to industrially produced fruit.
- Organically produced food contains more antioxidants (polyphenols), which are associated with a reduced risk of chronic diseases.
- A diet based on healthy, organic food demonstrably exposes consumers to fewer pesticides that are linked to diseases.
- Higher concentrations of vitamin C were found in leafy vegetables (spinach, lettuce, chard) grown organically compared to vegetables grown conventionally.
- Studies have found a higher content of total phenols in organically produced food compared to food produced conventionally. Phenols are important antioxidants that protect us from oxidative stress and thus prevent and treat diseases.
- It has been confirmed that reduced pesticide use increases the phenolic substances in the plant.
- Organic farming produces food with high nutritional value.
- Organic farming works for the benefit of nature and the environment and helps to preserve biodiversity and the variety of life (wild) animals through its farming methods.
- Organic farming tries to preserve and increase soil fertility and to use renewable resources to the greatest extent possible.
- Organically produced food is not more expensive than industrially produced food, as we must also take into account the costs of mitigating the consequences of the use of agricultural chemicals (water and soil pollution, etc.).
- Food produced naturally or organically is the only food that preserves soil fertility, the integrity and biodiversity of nature, and clean drinking water.

Eden od zelo pomembnih kriterijev zdrave prehrane je vidik pridelave. Torej, na kakšen način je bila pridelana naša hrana. Sodobno konvencionalno (intenzivno) kmetijstvo proizvaja hrano, obteženo s pesticidi in s pomočjo mineralnih gnojil, ki nepopravljivo škodujejo rodovitnosti zemlje, zdravju in življenju. Redna uporaba omenjenih sredstev za seboj pušča opustošenje prsti, ki postane nerodovitna, zbita in mrtva.
Konvencionalno kmetijstvo je z uporabo umetnih mineralnih gnojil (dušika in fosforja v njih) povzročilo rast in obilnost pridelka, a tudi njegovo prehranjenost, zaradi česar so rastline in pridelek postale manj odporne in bolj dovzetne za bolezni in škodljivce ter druge vplive okolja.
Rešitev je konvencionalno kmetijstvo našlo v pesticidih (herbicidi, fungicidi, insekticidi …), ki so jih pričeli uporabljati za varstvo ranljivih rastlin in pridelka. Tako je konvencionalno kmetijstvo nadvladalo dobo ekološkega kmetovanja, uporaba fitofarmacevtskih sredstev (pesticidi) pa je na dolgi rok uničila življenje pod in nad tlemi.
Doba umetnih gnojil in pesticidov je zmanjšala biotsko raznolikost življenja, v zemlji (in nad njo) pa naglo ubila celotno paleto (mikro)življenja: od poljskih rož in rastlin, deževnikov, pajkov, mokric, pršic do mikroorganizmov …
Danes so celo deževniki ogrožena vrsta. V Nemčiji, denimo, je kar 65 % od 43 raziskanih vrst deževnikov opredeljenih za redke do izredno redke vrste. Kar je nepredstavljiv podatek za prihodnost, saj iztrebki deževnikov vsebujejo kar 5x več magnezija in dušika, 7x več fosforja in kar 11x več kalija, kot ga vsebuje dobra vrtna zemlja.
Poleg tega, da konvencionalno kmetijstvo škoduje življenju in ekosistemom, pa porablja več energije na enoto pridelka in končnega izdelka ter onesnažuje podtalnico in druge vodne vire.
Hrana pridelana na konvencionalen način je osiromašena biotsko aktivnih snovi in mikroelementov ter vsebuje več strupov in nitratov, ki neposredno škodujejo našemu zdravju. Veliko razlogov torej, da se odločimo za sonaravno ali ekološko pridelano hrano.
Sonaravna ali ekološka pridelava hrane
Sonaravnost upošteva zakone narave in vse njene vidike življenja ter poskuša povsem odpraviti ali v največji meri zmanjšati vpliv na okolje v najširšem smislu, s smotrno (upo)rabo naravnih virov.
Ekološka pridelava pa je oblika kmetovanja, katere cilj je pridobivanje hrane z uporabo naravnih snovi in procesov (brez uporabe mineralnih gnojil, kemično-sintetičnih sredstev za varstvo rastlin in gensko spremenjenih organizmov) ter s tem omejeno in v čim manjši meri vplivati na okolje.
Posebna veja ekološkega kmetijstva pa je t. i. miroljubno kmetijstvo, ki je v svojem bistvu najbolj zavezano naravi in okolju, saj za gnojenje polj ne uporablja hlevskega gnoja, niti gnojil, pridobljenih iz mrtvih rejnih živali, [i] predvsem pa ne izkorišča živali v nobeni obliki: ne za živinorejo niti mlekarstvo.
Kljub vsebinski podobnosti pa termina »sonaravna pridelava« in »ekološka pridelava« nista sinonima. Sonaravna pridelava je širši pojem. To pomeni, da je ekološka pridelava [ii] vrsta sonaravne pridelave, ali drugače: ekološko kmetijstvo je vrsta sonaravnega kmetijstva.
In takšno kmetijstvo je človeštvo poznalo vse do konca 19. stoletja, ko so se pojavila prva mineralna gnojila. Kasneje je kemična industrija bojne pline iz prve svetovne vojne razvila v snovi, ki jih poznamo pod imenom pesticidi (insekticidi, herbicidi …) – za vzgojo rastlinskih sort, namenjenih naši prehrani in hrani za (rejne) živali.
Podpora ekološkim kmetovalcem je pomembna ne samo zaradi učinkov ekološke hrane na naše zdravje, pač pa tudi zaradi omejenega vpliva, ki ga ima takšno kmetovanje na okolje in naravo. Če res želimo ohraniti bogastvo, raznolikost in pestrost vseh oblik življenja našim zanamcem, moramo biti pametnejši, predvsem pa v svojem delovanju bolj sočutni in obzirni.
Še nekaj prednosti ekološko pridelane hrane
- Sveže, ekološko pridelano sadje vsebuje v poprečju več vitaminov, mineralov, encimov in ostalih mikro hranil, v primerjavi z industrijsko pridelanim sadjem.
- Ekološko pridelana hrana vsebuje več antioksidantov (polifenolov), katere povezujejo z zmanjšanjem tveganja za nastanek kroničnih bolezni.
- Način prehranjevanja, ki temelji na zdravi ekološki prehrani, dokazano manj izpostavlja potrošnike tistim pesticidom, ki so povezani z boleznimi.
- V listnati zelenjavi (špinača, zelena solata, blitva), pridelani na ekološki način, so bile najdene višje koncentracije vitamina C v primerjavi z zelenjavo, pridelano na konvencionalen način.
- Raziskave so ugotovile večjo vsebnost skupnih fenolov [iii] v ekološko pridelani hrani, v primerjavi s hrano, pridelano na konvencionalen način. Fenoli so pomembni antioksidanti, ki nas varujejo pred oksidativnim stresom in s tem preprečujejo in zdravijo bolezni.
- Potrjeno je, da zmanjšana uporaba pesticidov vpliva na povečanje fenolnih snovi v rastlini.
- Ekološko kmetovanje prideluje živila visoke prehranske vrednosti.
- Ekološka pridelava deluje v prid Naravi in okolja ter z načinom kmetovanja pomaga ohranjati biotsko raznovrstnost in raznolikost življenja (divjih) živali.
- Ekološka pridelava poskuša ohranjati in povečati rodovitnost zemlje ter v čim večji meri uporabljati obnovljive vire.
- Ekološko pridelana hrana ni dražja od industrijsko pridelane hrane, saj moramo upoštevati tudi stroške za odpravljanje posledic uporabe kmetijskih kemikalij (zastrupljanje vode, prsti …).
- Hrana, pridelana na sonaraven oz. ekološki način, je edina, ki ohranja rodovitnost prsti, neokrnjenost in biotsko raznovrstnost narave in čisto pitno vodo.

Background
The need for sleep remains one of the most fascinating mysteries in biology. The effects of sleep can only be investigated based on the consequences of its deprivation. These can be chronic or temporary and manifest in cognition, mood, attention, and overall health. Many scientists have proposed theories about the role of sleep, ranging from its function in conserving energy, evolutionary adaptation, and neurocognitive functions to maintaining brain plasticity, physical health, and the health of the nervous system. However, only a few of these functions have been thoroughly researched.

Purpose
In a comprehensive article from 2015, Barone and Krieger present various theories about why sleep is important and cite data from different studies on the consequences of sleep deprivation.

Results
The most common explanation is that the purpose of sleep is to conserve energy. However, this is not the case during REM sleep, when brain energy metabolism is increased compared to other sleep stages and reaches a level of energy expenditure similar to wakefulness, even though the body is immobile. Some scientists believe that energy conservation cannot be the primary function of sleep, as the amount of energy saved during sleep is negligible.

Nevertheless, the evolutionary drive to expend energy during wakefulness comes at a cost, so sleep is a time when energy reserves are used to regulate the deficit created by wakefulness – essentially, for cellular repair, immune functions, and the reorganization of neural networks. According to this theory, which is based on an evolutionary principle, the sleep-wake cycle evolved to optimize energy expenditure while simultaneously meeting all necessary biological processes.

The theory of synaptic homeostasis suggests that sleep is the price the brain pays for plasticity, that is, the brain's ability to change its structure. The authors of this study argue that learning requires strengthening brain connections, which increases the cell's energy needs. During sleep, neuronal connections are strengthened and weakened through spontaneous neuronal activity.

Therefore, chronic sleep deprivation could lead to long-term changes in brain connections, which explains why it takes longer to recover from chronic sleep deprivation compared to acute sleep deprivation.

Sleep is therefore thought to be linked to brain plasticity and to enhance memory. Both REM sleep and slow-wave sleep are thought to promote different types of learning and memory consolidation. However, many questions remain unanswered in this area, such as why some antidepressants eliminate the REM sleep phase, but people who take them do not have memory problems.

It has been found that people who suffer from insomnia are twice as likely to develop depression. Insomnia is also one of the first symptoms of depression. The results of some studies show that acute sleep deprivation increases the tendency towards risky behavior and limits the ability to make emotional and cognitive moral judgments.

Researchers made an interesting discovery in mice, where they discovered the existence of a system for cleaning or removing toxins from the brain, called the glymphatic system. Sleep is thought to stimulate this "cleaning" activity, during which the glymphatic system removes potentially neurotoxic proteins, such as amyloid beta, which is known to contribute to the development of Alzheimer's disease. Some studies even suggest that the quality and duration of sleep could be factors in predicting the onset of Alzheimer's disease.

Physical Health
The quality of sleep affects the immune system. Sleep contributes to the normal functioning of the immune system, and sleep disturbances affect both innate and acquired immunity and can consequently increase the risk of developing inflammatory diseases, such as some types of cardiovascular diseases or cancer, as well as depression.

If we sleep poorly, get too little sleep, or have fragmented sleep for just one night, or if we compensate for the lack of sleep with daytime rest, this does not increase the presence of biological markers of inflammation. If we take a nap during the day after a sleepless night, this can even contribute to reducing the release of inflammatory substances. However, this does not apply to people with chronic sleep problems, in whom even one night of disturbed sleep can trigger the release of biological markers of inflammation.

The greatest risk of developing cardiovascular diseases is in people who sleep less than 5 hours a night, but even sleeping less than 7 hours a night increases the risk. However, there are also studies that show a link between too much sleep and cardiovascular problems.

Increasingly, studies are linking short sleep duration with increased hunger and appetite, impaired glucose tolerance, increased risk of weight gain, and the development of type 2 diabetes. It seems that sleep debt negatively affects endocrine functions and carbohydrate metabolism, and the effects are similar to normal aging, so sleep debt could accelerate the progression of age-related chronic diseases.

Shift work and disrupted circadian rhythms can lead to epigenetic changes in circadian genes. These genes are involved in regulating cell division and DNA repair. In the long term, night workers have been found to have an increased risk of breast, prostate, colon, and other malignant tumors.

The EPIC-Potsdam study (European Prospective Investigation into Cancer and Nutrition) showed that people who sleep less than 6 hours a night are more likely to develop cancer than those who sleep 7 hours a night. Other studies have shown that sleeping too much (more than 9 hours) or too little (less than 5 hours) can increase the risk of developing cancer.

Conclusions
The need for sleep remains a mystery for scientists, but the effects of sleep deprivation are clear. Poor quality or lack of sleep can be linked to type 2 diabetes, heart attack, and other cardiovascular diseases, obesity, cancer, and an overall increased risk of mortality. For an adult, it is therefore recommended to get approximately 7-8 hours of sleep per day.

The authors conclude that adequate quantity and good quality of sleep are essential for improving health and preventing the development of some diseases.

Summary: Valentina Oblak, MSc in Cognitive Science.

Izhodišča
Potreba po spanju ostaja ena najočarljivejših skrivnosti biologije. Učinke spanja lahko raziskujemo le na podlagi posledic njegovega pomanjkanja. Te so lahko kronične ali začasne in jih zaznamo pri kogniciji, razpoloženju, pozornosti ter splošnem zdravstvenem stanju. Številni znanstveniki so zastavili teorije o vlogi te dejavnosti: od funkcije spanja pri ohranjanju energije, evolucijskem prilagajanju in nevrokognitivnih funkcijah do ohranjanja plastičnosti možganov, fizičnega zdravja in zdravja živčnega sistema. Raziskanih pa je le nekaj funkcij spanja.
Namen
V preglednem članku iz leta 2015 predstavljata Barone in Krieger različne teorije o tem, zakaj je spanje pomembno, in navajata podatke iz različnih raziskav o posledicah pomanjkanja spanja.
Rezultati
Najpogosteje se navaja, da je namen spanja ohranjanje energije. To pa ne drži na primer med REM spanjem, ko je možganski energetski metabolizem povečan v primerjavi z ostalimi fazami spanja in doseže nivo energetske porabe med budnostjo, pa čeprav je telo negibno. Nekateri znanstveniki so sicer mnenja, da ohranjanje energije ne more biti primarna funkcija spanja, saj je količina prihranjene energije med spanjem zanemarljiva.
Pa vendar evolucijski nagon k energetski porabi med budnostjo nekaj stane, zato je spanje trenutek, ko zaloge energije porabimo za uravnavanje primanjkljaja, ki ga ustvari budnost – tako rekoč, za celična popravila, imunske funkcije in reorganizacijo nevronskih mrež. Po tej teoriji, ki izhaja iz evolucijskega principa, se je torej cikel spanja in budnosti razvil, da bi človek optimiziral energetsko porabo in obenem zadostil vsem potrebnim biološkim procesom.
Teorija sinaptične homeostaze predpostavlja, da je spanje cena, ki jo možgani plačujejo za plastičnost, to je sposobnost možganov, da spreminjajo svojo strukturo. Avtorji te raziskave navajajo, da učenje zahteva krepitev možganskih povezav, kar poveča celično potrebo po energiji. V spanju pa se nevronske povezave s spontano aktivnostjo nevronov krepijo in šibijo.
Pri kroničnem pomanjkanju spanja bi torej lahko prišlo do dolgoročnih sprememb v možganskih povezavah, kar tudi utemelji dejstvo, da za nadoknadenje v tem primeru potrebujemo več časa kot pri akutnem pomanjkanju spanja.
Spanje bi naj torej bilo povezano s plastičnostjo možganov in krepilo spomin. Tako REM spanje kot spanje počasnih valov naj bi spodbujalo različne vrste učenja in utrjevanja spomina. Tudi na tem področju ostaja več nejasnosti, kot na primer, zakaj nekateri antidepresivi izničijo REM fazo spanja, a ljudje, ki jih uživajo, nimajo težav s spominom.
Ugotovili so, da kdor trpi za nespečnostjo, ima dvakrat večjo možnost, da razvije depresijo. Obenem je nespečnost tudi eden izmed prvih simptomov depresije. Izsledki nekaterih raziskav kažejo, da akutno pomanjkanje spanja poveča nagnjenje k tveganemu vedenju ter omeji sposobnost čustvene in kognitivne moralne razsodbe.
Do zanimivega odkritja so raziskovalci prišli pri miših, pri katerih so odkrili obstoj sistema za čiščenje oziroma odstranjevanje toksinov iz možganov, ki mu pravimo glimfatični sistem. Spanje naj bi spodbudilo prav to „čistilno“ dejavnost, tekom katere glimfatični sistem odstranjuje potencialno nevrotoksične proteine, kot je na primer amiloid beta, za katerega je znano, da pripomore k nastanku Alzheimerjeve bolezni. Nekatere raziskave celo nakazujejo, da bi lahko bila kakovost in trajanje spanja med elementi, na podlagi katerih bi napovedali nastop Alzheimerjeve bolezni.
Telesno zdravje
Kakovost spanja vpliva na imunski sistem. Spanje pripomore k normalnemu delovanju imunskega sistema, motnje spanja pa vplivajo na prirojeno in pridobljeno imunost ter posledično lahko povečajo tveganje za razvoj bolezni, povezanih z vnetji, kot so nekatere vrste srčno-žilnih bolezni ali raka, pa tudi depresija.
Če spimo slabo, premalo ali fragmentirano le eno noč, ali pa če pomanjkanje kompenziramo z dnevnim počitkom, to ne poveča prisotnosti bioloških označevalcev vnetja. Če zadremamo čez dan po neprespani noči, lahko s tem celo prispevamo k zmanjšanju izločanja vnetnih snovi. To pa ne velja za osebe s kroničnimi težavami pri spanju, pri katerih lahko že ena sama noč motenega spanja sproži sproščanje bioloških označevalcev vnetja.
Največje tveganje za razvoj srčno-žilnih bolezni imajo osebe, ki spijo manj kot 5 ur na noč, toda že če spimo manj kot 7 ur na noč, je tveganje povečano. Obstajajo pa tudi raziskave, ki kažejo na povezavo med predolgim spancem in srčno-žilnimi težavami.
Čedalje več raziskav povezuje kratko trajanje spanja s povečano lakoto in apetitom, #moteno toleranco za glukozo, povečanim tveganjem za pridobitev telesne teže in za razvoj sladkorne bolezni tipa 2. Zdi se, da spalni dolg negativno učinkuje na endokrine funkcije in metabolizem ogljikovih hidratov, učinki pa so podobni navadnemu staranju in bi lahko zato spalni dolg pospeševal potek kroničnih bolezni, vezanih na starost.
Delovne izmene in porušen cirkadiani ritem lahko privedejo do epigenetskih sprememb cirkadianih genov. Ti geni so vpleteni v urejanje deljenja celic in popravljanja DNK-ja. Dolgoročno so pri nočnih delavcih zaznali povečano tveganje za raka dojke, prostate, debelega črevesa in drugih malignih tvorb.
Raziskava EPIC-Potsdam (European Prospective Investigation into Cancer and Nutrition – evropska prospektivna raziskava raka in prehrane) je pokazala, da imajo osebe, ki spijo manj kot 6 ur na noč, več možnosti za razvoj raka kot tiste, ki spijo 7 ur na noč. Druge raziskave so pokazale, da predolgo spanje, to je več kot 9 ur, ali prekratko spanje (manj kot 5 ur) lahko vplivata na povečano možnost za razvoj rakastih obolenj.
Zaključki
Potreba po spanju ostaja zagonetka za znanstvenike, učinki pomanjkanja spanja pa so jasno razvidni. Slaba kakovost ali odsotnost spanja sta lahko povezani s sladkorno boleznijo tipa 2, infarktom in drugimi srčno-žilnimi boleznimi, prekomerno telesno težo, rakom in celokupno večjim tveganjem za umrljivost. Za odraslega človeka zato okvirno priporočajo 7-8 ur spanja dnevno.
Avtorja zaključujeta, da sta ustrezna količina in dobra kakovost spanca ključnega pomena za izboljšanje zdravja in preprečevanje nastanka nekaterih bolezni.

To combat pests, it is necessary to consider the specifics of their behavior and reproduction. Worker ants search for food, and the queen is responsible for reproduction. If all efforts are directed at destroying the workers, there will be no positive result. Only when the queen is destroyed will all the insects disappear. While the use of fossil fuels has raised the standard of living for most of the world's population in the last century, it has also darkened the future with climate change. It is becoming clear that we must urgently reduce greenhouse gas emissions. Carbon dioxide (CO2) is an indicator of several greenhouse gases (methane, F-gases, nitrous oxide – these are called CO2 equivalents). Around 90 percent of CO2 emissions caused by human activities come from fossil fuels, while the remainder is due to agriculture and industry. On average, each resident of the EU produces approximately 9 tons of CO2 per year.
The aim of the EduFootprint project (a 28-month modular Interreg MED project co-financed by the European Regional Development Fund) is to improve the skills of owners and managers of public buildings, especially educational institutions, for more efficient energy use, thereby reducing the environmental footprint of these buildings. The project involves 53 buildings: kindergartens, primary and secondary schools, and university buildings.
The project focuses on buildings because people spend 90 percent of their time in them. Therefore, they must provide a high-quality living environment while also being designed to minimize their environmental footprint. In the case of a school, this footprint is first related to construction, and in the operational phase, the impact on the environment depends on energy use, mobility, and other activities, including food. Buildings consume approximately 40 percent of the energy in the EU and are responsible for one-third of black carbon emissions. Energy efficiency means doing more with less consumption: an energy-efficient building consumes less energy and has a smaller environmental footprint.
To compare the efficiency of school buildings, we can calculate energy consumption per square meter of building area or in relation to the number of students. The environmental footprint of a school can be determined based on energy consumption and emission factors, such as the amount of CO2 in kilograms. In the EduFootprint project, a model of Edu-points was developed, which represents an original way to determine a comprehensive assessment of the school's impact on the environment. The calculation takes into account the parameters of school CO2 emissions: thermal energy, electricity, passenger transport, and paper use. School buildings are then ranked on a scale from 0 Edu-points (an unsuccessful school with an excessive impact on the environment or too high CO2 emissions) to 100 Edu-points (an extremely efficient school).
To better understand the impact of buildings on the environment, the project also developed a mobile application called EduFootprint. This application, by displaying energy consumption and related CO2 emissions, helps school communities understand the impact of various factors on the environmental footprint of the educational process. The application has a simple and user-friendly interface where users can easily see what the environmental footprint of the school is and how many kilowatt-hours of energy the building consumes for heating, as well as track the consumption of kilowatt-hours of electricity and the accumulation of kilograms of paper. They can also see what the environmental impact is of traveling by different modes of transport.
Data from participating schools allows for a comparison of energy efficiency, and the interactive part helps users of the application learn about the factors that affect energy consumption and greenhouse gas emissions. Edu-points are calculated based on the normalization of each parameter (thermal energy or number of students) in relation to the highest value of that parameter from all test schools. The total Edu-point score for a selected school is the sum of the points for individual parameters, taking into account their impact. This helps users understand which are the most important CO2 emission parameters and where it makes sense to take action first. By moving the slider, they can then test the impact of individual factors and monitor changes in Edu-points: a higher number of points means lower energy consumption and a smaller environmental footprint of the building.
The EduFootprint application is designed for users of Android smartphones and is also publicly available in Slovenian in the Google Play Store at https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=si.specto.edufootprint or by searching for "edufootprint".

V projekt je vključenih 53 objektov: vrtcev, osnovnih in srednjih šol ter univerzitetnih stavb.

Zato nam morajo zagotoviti kakovostno bivalno okolje, hkrati pa morajo biti zasnovane tako, da je čim manjši njihov okoljski odtis. V primeru šole je ta odtis najprej povezan z gradnjo, v operativni fazi pa je vpliv na okolje odvisen od rabe energije, mobilnosti in drugih dejavnosti, vključno s prehrano. Stavbe porabijo približno 40 odstotkov energije v EU in so odgovorne za tretjino emisij črnega ogljika. Energetska učinkovitost pomeni, da storimo več z manj porabe: energetsko učinkovita stavba porabi manj energije in povzroča manjši okoljski odtis.
Za primerjavo učinkovitosti šolskih stavb lahko izračunamo porabo energije na kvadratni meter površine stavbe ali v sorazmerju s številom učencev, okoljski odtis šole pa lahko določimo glede na porabo energije in dejavnike izpustov, kot je količina CO2 v kilogramih. V projektu EduFootprint so razvili model Edu-točk, ki pomenijo izviren način za določanje celovite ocene vpliva šole na okolje. Šolske stavbe potem razvrstimo na lestvici od 0 Edu-točk (neuspešna šola, prekomeren vpliv na okolje ali previsoki izpusti CO2) do 100 Edu-točk (izjemno učinkovita šola).

What is Latin?
Latin is a classical language that belongs to the Indo-European language family. Many languages in the Italic branch of the Indo-European language family evolved from Latin.
When looking at the history of the Latin language, it is one of the languages spoken in the area of Latium, Italy, and Rome was a city in Latium. The first known inscriptions in Latin date back to the 6th century BC. The Latin alphabet originated from the Etruscan alphabet. The Latin language became the dominant language as Rome began to expand its influence to other parts of Italy and then to Europe.
Classical Latin is a modern term used to refer to the written form of Latin. When we say that we are studying Latin, we are referring to Classical Latin, as many modern Latin textbooks and courses look at texts written in Classical Latin. Vulgar Latin is a term that identifies the spoken language used by people at that time. Some authors, such as Cicero and Petronius, used Vulgar Latin in their works. This is the language that later evolved into the Italic/Romance languages, such as Italian, Spanish, French, Portuguese, etc.
The Latin language began to lose its position as the leading language of education and religion throughout Europe in the 15th century. It was mainly replaced by languages that evolved from Latin or were heavily influenced by it. The Latin language is still used by the Roman Catholic Church and Christian priests. It is also the official language of the Vatican. Furthermore, Latin terminology is used in fields such as biology, medicine, and theology.
The Latin language can be called a dead language for several reasons. It is no longer anyone's native language, nor is it used for everyday communication. While Latin is still studied, it cannot be considered a developing language.
When analyzing the structure of Latin, it can be observed that it is a highly inflected language. Latin has three distinct genders, four verb conjugations, seven noun cases, three persons and moods, six tenses, two voices, aspects, and numbers.

Around 1150 BC, the Egyptian pharaoh Ramses V died of blackpox. His mummy is the first officially documented case of blackpox. This was recorded in 429 BC by the ancient Greek historian in his book, The History of the Peloponnesian War, when describing an epidemic of blackpox.
